stress.rewardMessage: Chapter objectives completed. All eligible rewards have been added to your inventory.

open.contract: Activate the currently available chapter reward. Journey data provides claim availability.

skip.contract: Jump to opening after the 120 ms tap debounce.

claim-chapter-tasks.contract: Submit one idempotent chapter claim and display the returned LastGrant.

dismiss-last-grant.contract: Dismiss LastGrant and restore Journey input.

reveal.label: Open chapter chest
reveal.interrupt: Lock the flow during reveal. Skip jumps to opening. A teardown cancels visual tracks and restores input; disposition follows the authoritative grant.

dismiss.label: Dismiss rewards
dismiss.interrupt: During close, input remains captured. Restore Journey and focus on the next reward indicator.
